announcements.headline: Appointment of Non-Executive Director
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a change in the board composition by adding a non-executive director, which is a standard governance update. It generally indicates an effort to strengthen board oversight or expertise without implying immediate strategic or financial shifts.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Dealings
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a director or person discharging managerial responsibilities has executed a transaction in the company's shares. Such dealings are routine regulatory disclosures and typically carry limited immediate significance for general shareholders unless accompanied by further context regarding volume or intent.

announcements.headline: Director / PDMR Dealings
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a person discharging managerial responsibilities has engaged in share dealing activity. Such filings are routine regulatory disclosures that confirm compliance but generally do not signal specific strategic shifts or material financial events for shareholders.
